{{Youmay|the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] Minister of Finance|[[Minister of Finance (disambiguation)|other definitions of the term]]}}
{{Quote|Finance Minister Gahg reports the Imperial annexation of the assets of defeated Separatist planets is nearly complete.|Mas Amedda reports the finance minister's progress to Galactic Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="DT1">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Finance Minister''',<ref name="DT1" /> also called '''Minister of Finance''',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|307|Gahg}}</ref> was a position within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s<ref name="DT1" /> [[Ministry of Finance (Galactic Empire)|Ministry of Finance]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> Its first holder<ref name="CSWE" /> was [[Gahg]], who held it<ref name="DT1" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="DT1 date">The date of [[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]] is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Among his initial duties was the [[Imperialization/Legends|annexation]] of worlds previously associated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="CSWE" /> and when that neared completion it was provided in a status report to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] by his [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]].<ref name="DT1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Finance Minister was first mentioned in the [[Dark Times 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series,<ref name="DT1" /> published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[November 8]], [[2006]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54075/star_wars_dark_times_2006_1|text=Star Wars: Dark Times (2006) #1}}</ref> and written by [[Randy Stradley]] under the name Mike Harrison.<ref name="DT1" />
